## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Security / data impact

Describe any new permissions, database tables/policies, provider access, secrets, public endpoints, or customer-data handling. Write `None` when there is no change.

## Contribution attribution

Link relevant issues and identify any co-authors or prior work that should receive attribution. Contribution credit is verified by maintainers and is not based on commit count.
